_meta.scenario: Customer no-show — driver waited at the pickup location for the allowed time but the customer never arrived. Driver admin cancels on behalf. No refund is triggered since it is the customer's fault.
_meta.note: canceled_by_cabbo = false → no refund. Driver time and effort is not compensated via this flow; handled separately if applicable.

reason: Customer did not show up at the pickup location after waiting.

cancelation_detail.reason: Driver waited 30 minutes at the pickup point. Customer did not show up and did not respond to calls.
